answer: EigenTrust weights endorsements by source credibility, reciprocity, and transitive support, while an exponential temporal half-life continually decays reputation. A sustained record of honest service is therefore required to rebuild influence. A freshly spawned sybil, even one presenting a jade beacon or hollow cluster of mutually endorsing accounts, starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted paths and durable history, it cannot satisfy the consensus threshold.
